column4: Channel Status Table Entry - Single Unit Channel
Symbol
Content
Bits
This field contains the address of the unit area table
SUNAA
(UAT) attached to the channel. If the unit has never
been assigned, the entry will be zero. This field is
set at IPL, and by I-O assignment, the I-O change
command, and the special assignment package. The
field is referred to by the identifier, the receptor,
the I-O change command, the special assignment
package, and I-O assignment.
SCHAVL
- Channel is available
1 - Channel is not available
A channel is available when it is physically attached to
the exchange and is capable of being actuated by MCP.
This indicator exists in the channel status table of either
a single or multi-unit channel. It is set at IPL, and
sometimes by the I-O change command. It is tested by
the identifier (as an internal MCP check upon actuation),
by special assignment, I-O assignment and I-O change.
SCHOP
• - Channel not operating
1 - Channel operating
This indicator exists in the channel status table of either
a single or multi-unit channel. It is set by the actuator
routines and reset by the receptor. It is tested by the
identifier, I-O change command and special assignment,
Job Control 4 and UNASSIGN and the $FREE routine.
SMULTI
0 - Single-unit channel
1 - Multi-unit channel
This indicator exists in the channel status table of
either a single or multi-unit channel. It is set at IPL.
It is tested by most actuator routines, I-O change
command, special assignment, UNASSIGN, I-O assign-
ment and receptor.
SUNAVL
0 - Unit is available
1 - Unit is not available
A unit is available when it is physically attached to a
channel and is capable of being actuated by MCP. This
indicator exists in the channel status table for single
unit channels and in the unit status table for multi-unit
channels. It is set at IPL and sometimes by the I-O
change command. It is tested by the identifier, I-O
change, special assignment and I-O assignment.
